name: vessels
title: Vessels
description: Synthetic vessel telemetry: six fictional vessels, one reading every six seconds, 1–14 September 2026 UTC. Speed and wind in knots, wave height in metres, water temperature in °C, lat/lon in degrees.
license: Synthetic, generated by time-blast (src/engine/dataset.ts); no third-party data

name: vessels-small
title: Vessels (small)
description: Synthetic vessel telemetry (small): one reading per minute, 1–14 September 2026 UTC; t is Unix epoch milliseconds, vessel an index 0–5.
license: Synthetic, generated by the first time-blast prototype; no third-party data

name: weather
title: Hourly weather in 12 European cities, 2023–2024
description: Hourly weather (ERA5 reanalysis via Open-Meteo) for 12 European cities, 2023-01-01 to 2024-12-31 UTC. temperature °C at 2 m, humidity % relative, precipitation mm in the preceding hour, wind_speed km/h at 10 m, cloud_cover % of sky, pressure hPa at mean sea level.
license: CC BY 4.0 (Open-Meteo; ERA5 data: Copernicus Climate Change Service)

name: flights
title: US domestic flights, 2024-06
description: Every domestic flight of the reporting US carriers in June 2024 (BTS on-time data). scheduled_departure is local time at the origin; delays, taxi and air times in minutes (negative delay = early); distance in miles. flights.carrier = carriers.code; flights.origin and flights.dest = airports.code.
license: Public domain (US DOT Bureau of Transportation Statistics; OurAirports data is public domain)

name: flights-2024
title: US domestic flights, 2024
description: Every domestic flight of the reporting US carriers in 2024, January to December (BTS on-time data). scheduled_departure is local time at the origin; delays, taxi and air times in minutes (negative delay = early); distance in miles. flights.carrier = carriers.code; flights.origin and flights.dest = airports.code.
license: Public domain (US DOT Bureau of Transportation Statistics; OurAirports data is public domain)

name: cities
title: World cities over 15,000 inhabitants
description: Every populated place with at least 15,000 inhabitants (GeoNames cities15000) and every country. cities.country_code = countries.code. feature_code: PPLC capital, PPLA first-order admin seat, PPLA2..4 lower seats, PPL other place. elevation in metres (digital elevation model), area_km2 in km², population in people.

name: nyc-taxi
title: NYC yellow taxi trips, January–March 2024
description: NYC TLC yellow taxi trip records, January to March 2024 (pickup times are local New York time). One row per trip. Money columns are US dollars: total_amount = fare_amount + extra + mta_tax + tip_amount + tolls_amount + improvement_surcharge + congestion_surcharge + airport_fee (tips are recorded for card payments only; cash tips are missing). trip_distance in miles. Trip duration: date_diff('minute', pickup_time, dropoff_time). trips.pickup_zone_id and trips.dropoff_zone_id = zones.zone_id; zones has borough, zone name, service_zone and the zone centroid lat/lon (NULL for zones 264/265: unknown / outside NYC). Removed as broken: pickups outside the period, dropoff before pickup or over 24 h later, trip_distance over 500 miles, negative fares or totals (refunds, voided records) and totals over $5,000.
license: NYC TLC Trip Record Data, NYC Open Data (public, free to use; https://www.nyc.gov/site/tlc/about/tlc-trip-record-data.page)
